title: Ragdoll arena physics — soft-block colliders, lifetime + visual playtest
notes: Hot on the heels of PR #158 (impulse-to-root + 0.5× scale + floor/hard-block colliders). This sprint closes the arena-physics story: soft-blocks join the static colliders, ragdolls fade out after a few seconds so corpses don't pile up across a round, and a playwright spec captures the visual contract so future ragdoll changes can't silently break it.

Soft-block destruction already calls world.removeEntity(id), and physics-sync-system phase-1 releases the Rapier body when the entity disappears, so adding RigidBody3D+Collider3D to the soft-block prefab is a single-file change with no extra teardown code.

Lifetime story keeps the corpse on screen long enough to feel impactful but cleans up before the round resets — round-reset already handles bulk teardown via RagdollTeardownRequest on every ragdoll root, but mid-round multi-kills used to leak bodies until the round ended.

stories.title: Add RigidBody3D + Collider3D to the soft-block prefab
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/prefabs/soft-block.prefab.json — add RigidBody3D{type:fixed} + Collider3D{kind:box,size:[1,1,1]}. Soft blocks are spawned at scene-build + destroyed mid-round via world.removeEntity in blast-propagation; physics-sync-system's phase-1 release loop already drops the Rapier body when the entity disappears, so no extra teardown wiring needed. Ragdolls now collide with intact soft blocks instead of clipping through them.
verification: acceptance: examples/kaboom-crew/prefabs/soft-block.prefab.json gains RigidBody3D{type:fixed} + Collider3D{kind:box,size:[0.9,0.9,0.9]} (matching the Transform.scale). engine:check passes; 267/267 kaboom unit tests green. Soft blocks are now physical from spawn; physics-sync-system phase-1 release handles teardown when blast-propagation removes the entity, so no extra wiring.

stories.title: Unit test: soft-block removeEntity releases its Rapier body
stories.summary: tests/unit/soft-block-physics-cleanup.test.ts (or extend an existing physics test) — spawn a fixed body via RigidBody3D+Collider3D on an entity, tick physics-sync, observe registry has 1 body. Call world.removeEntity, tick again, assert registry.size() === 0 and adapter.bodyCount() === 0. Catches a regression in the entity-removal release loop in physics-sync-system.
verification: acceptance: tests/unit/physics-sync-system.test.ts adds 'S136 — releases the body when the entity itself is removed (soft-block destruction path)'. Mirrors the kaboom flow: setComponent RigidBody3D+Collider3D on a soft-block-shaped entity, fixedUpdate (registry.size() === 1, spy.released === []), removeEntity, fixedUpdate (registry.size() === 0, spy.released has 1 entry). 8/8 tests pass.

stories.title: RagdollLifetime component schema
stories.summary: schemas/components/ragdoll.schema.json — add RagdollLifetime { secondsRemaining: number } component. The ragdoll spawn-system writes it onto the root next to RagdollActive when a (new) RagdollTemplate.lifetimeSeconds is configured (defaults to undefined = no auto-cleanup). The lifetime-system (next story) decrements per fixedUpdate and issues RagdollTeardownRequest when it hits zero.
verification: acceptance: schemas/components/ragdoll.schema.json gains (1) ragdollLifetime component def { secondsRemaining: number, required } and (2) ragdollTemplate.lifetimeSeconds optional field (exclusiveMinimum 0). engine/physics/ragdoll/template-registry.ts RagdollTemplate TS contract mirrors the field. Existing 21 schema + template-registry tests still green; typecheck passes.

stories.title: Engine ragdoll lifetime-system: auto-teardown after N seconds
stories.summary: engine/physics/ragdoll/lifetime-system.ts (new) — fixedUpdate query on [RagdollActive, RagdollLifetime]; decrement secondsRemaining by dt; on ≤0 write RagdollTeardownRequest on the same root. Register from src/app.ts alongside the spawn/sync/teardown systems. Kaboom-bomber template gains lifetimeSeconds: 4 (one round = 90s, so a 4-second corpse is generous but cleans up before round end). Without lifetime, mid-round multi-kills accumulate bodies until the round timer's bulk teardown.
verification: acceptance: engine/physics/ragdoll/lifetime-system.ts (new) decrements RagdollLifetime.secondsRemaining by fixedDt each fixedUpdate; at ≤0 writes RagdollTeardownRequest on the root (only when not already present). Spawn-system stamps RagdollLifetime when the template declares lifetimeSeconds > 0. Teardown-system strips RagdollLifetime alongside RagdollState + RagdollActive. src/app.ts registers the lifetime system BEFORE teardown so zero-countdowns are disposed in the same tick. examples/kaboom-crew/src/characters/kaboom-bomber-ragdoll-template.ts gains lifetimeSeconds: 4. Typecheck passes; 25 ragdoll-related tests green.

stories.title: Unit test for the lifetime-system
stories.summary: tests/unit/ragdoll-lifetime.test.ts — set up a ragdoll root with RagdollActive + RagdollLifetime{secondsRemaining: 1.0}; tick lifetime-system at dt=1/60; after 60 ticks (1.0s) assert RagdollTeardownRequest is on the root and secondsRemaining ≤ 0. Also: bodies query empty after teardown-system runs.
verification: acceptance: tests/unit/ragdoll-lifetime.test.ts adds 5 tests — (1) per-tick dt decrement; (2) RagdollTeardownRequest fires when secondsRemaining hits zero (60th tick at dt=1/60 from 1.0s); (3) idempotent — doesn't clobber an existing teardown request (sentinel preserved); (4) ignores entities without RagdollLifetime (RagdollActive alone does not trigger); (5) multiple roots tick independently. All 5 pass.

stories.title: Playwright spec: ragdoll stays in arena after blast death
stories.summary: tests/e2e/kaboom-ragdoll-arena.spec.ts — load /?project=kaboom-crew, wait for the round to spawn + bots to start moving, place a bomb (via the kbd-press or commands probe) next to a bot, wait ~2s for the blast + ragdoll, snapshot the world. Assert: at least one RagdollBody-bearing entity exists, every body's world position.y is between -0.2 and 4.0, and X/Z are inside the floor extents (15×11 around (7, _, 5) for start.scene). Regression guard for the PR #158 impulse + floor/wall fixes.
stories.deferredReason: kaboom-crew bootstrap throws 'Entity "kaboom.game-state" already exists' under playwright (visible in dev server logs; HMR replay path) so window.__agf never gets set within the test timeout. Wiring a robust e2e for kaboom-crew first needs a separate sprint to either (a) make the bootstrap idempotent under HMR re-attach, or (b) add a fresh-dev-server playwright fixture that ignores the dev server reuse. The S136 unit tests (ragdoll-lifetime + physics-sync-system entity-release + spawn-sync impulse-to-root + the existing ragdoll-death-flow integration) cover the contract; manual playtest checklist in docs/qa/ragdoll-playtest.md covers the visual.
